name: CGenFF 2a5 (J. Comput. Chem. 2010)
source: Supporting Information of K. Vanommeslaeghe et al., J. Comput. Chem. 31, 671 (2010), doi:10.1002/jcc.21367 (jcc_21367_sm_suppinfo.tgz): par_all36_cgenff.prm and top_all36_cgenff.rtf, CGenFF v. 2a5
references: K. Vanommeslaeghe, E. Hatcher, C. Acharya, S. Kundu, S. Zhong, J. Shim, E. Darian, O. Guvench, P. Lopes, I. Vorobyov, A. D. MacKerell Jr., J. Comput. Chem. 31, 671 (2010), doi:10.1002/jcc.21367
notes: converted by CAPS (bench/ff/convert_charmm_prm.py) from par_all36_cgenff.prm, masses from top_all36_cgenff.rtf
parameter values as published in the Supporting Information of Vanommeslaeghe et al. 2010; CAPS's conversion

the file's NONBONDED line asks for an energy switch of the Lennard-Jones from 10 to 12 A (vswitch) and shifted electrostatics; CAPS uses CHARMM's force switch over the same range (vfswitch, as later CGenFF releases ask for) and long-range electrostatics
no water or ions: the Supporting Information's files define none (TIP3P comes with the CHARMM36 libraries)

atom types added in later CGenFF releases (thiocarbonyl, sulfone, sulfoxide, thiophosphate, epoxide, cyclobutyl, beta-lactam N, bipyrrole and N-aryl ring types, the terminal alkyne CG1T2) are not in 2a5; its typing rules leave them out

impropers where the topology's IMPR records put them: 97 centre environments (a centre's type and its neighbours') from 388 residues of top_all36_cgenff.rtf; where residues list one environment differently, the most common listing, with 71 exceptions for deeper environments (up to 6 bonds out) that list otherwise; the 13 parameter entries no IMPR record uses are never applied
